item.title: PennDOT seeks input from drivers on traffic safety
item.description: HARRISBURG, DAUPHIN COUNTY (WBRE/WYOU) — PennDOT is seeking input from Pennsylvania drivers regarding improvements to traffic safety. According to PennDOT, the survey is being offered to gain an understanding of drivers' habits to give a better idea for their program planning. Those interested in taking the poll can do so here.
